title: How to create a MAA account
answer: New users can register using their name, email, phone number, password and confirm password. Registration also requires agreeing to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Use the Get Started button on the home page to begin.

title: How to log in to MAA
answer: Existing users can log in from the Login option in the main navigation using their registered email or phone number and password.

title: Authentication module structure
answer: The Authentication module of MAA covers registration, login, and account creation, and is the first step before a user can access Food, Medicine, Travel, or Talk to MAA.

title: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
answer: When registering, users must agree to MAA's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Links to both are also available in the Company section of the website footer.

title: Is there a paid membership on MAA?
answer: The current MAA description does not define a separate paid membership plan. Access to Food, Medicine, Travel and Talk to MAA is available once a user creates a free account and logs in.
